pipelines.name: n4-bias-correction
pipelines.label: n4-bias-correction@1
pipelines.description: Correct the low-frequency intensity non-uniformity (bias field) of each session's T1-weighted image with ANTs N4BiasFieldCorrection. One session is one unit; no GPU, no licence.

parameters.name: Image dimensionality
parameters.description: The image's dimensionality, 3 for a structural volume.

parameters.name: Shrink factor
parameters.description: Downsampling that trades accuracy for speed; 4 is ANTs' default for a volume.

descriptor.name: n4-bias-correction
descriptor.description: Correct the low-frequency intensity non-uniformity (bias field) of each session's T1-weighted image with ANTs N4BiasFieldCorrection. One session is one unit; no GPU, no licence.

inputs.name: Image dimensionality
inputs.description: The image's dimensionality, 3 for a structural volume.

inputs.name: Shrink factor
inputs.description: Downsampling that trades accuracy for speed; 4 is ANTs' default for a volume.

descriptor.command-line: bash -c 'set -eu; shopt -s nullglob; cd [InputDataset]; n=0; for f in sub-*/ses-*/anat/*_T1w.nii.gz sub-*/ses-*/anat/*_T1w.nii; do d=[OutputLocation]/$(dirname "$f"); mkdir -p "$d"; b=$(basename "$f"); b=${b%.gz}; b=${b%.nii}; b=${b%_T1w}; N4BiasFieldCorrection -d [DIM] -s [SHRINK] -i "$f" -o "$d/${b}_desc-n4_T1w.nii.gz"; n=$((n+1)); done; echo "N4 corrected $n images"'

pipelines.name: synthstrip
pipelines.label: synthstrip@1
pipelines.description: Skull-strip each session's T1-weighted image with SynthStrip: a binary brain mask, the brain-extracted image, and the brain's volume in mm3. One session is one unit; CPU, no licence.

checks.description: A mask smaller than 0.7 litres has cut into the brain
A mask larger than 2.2 litres has taken skull or neck

parameters.name: Exclude CSF
parameters.description: Exclude the cerebrospinal fluid from the mask (SynthStrip --no-csf) for a tighter brain.

parameters.name: Mask border
parameters.description: Grow (or with a negative value shrink) the mask's boundary by this many millimetres.

parameters.name: Threads
parameters.description: The threads mri_synthstrip uses for one session.

columns.name: brain_volume
columns.description: The volume inside the brain mask

descriptor.command-line: bash -c 'set -u; shopt -s nullglob; cd [InputDataset]; for f in sub-*/ses-*/anat/*_T1w.nii.gz; do d=[OutputLocation]/$(dirname "$f"); mkdir -p "$d"; b=$(basename "$f" .nii.gz); b=${b%_T1w}; mri_synthstrip -i "$f" -o "$d/${b}_desc-brain_T1w.nii.gz" -m "$d/${b}_desc-brain_mask.nii.gz" -b [BORDER] -t [THREADS] [NOCSF] || continue; v=$(fspython -c "import sys, numpy, nibabel; i = nibabel.load(sys.argv[1]); print(float(numpy.count_nonzero(i.get_fdata() > 0) * numpy.prod(i.header.get_zooms()[:3])))" "$d/${b}_desc-brain_mask.nii.gz") || continue; printf "brain_volume\n%s\n" "$v" > "$d/${b}_desc-brain_volume.csv"; done'

pipelines.name: samseg-lesions
pipelines.label: samseg-lesions@1
pipelines.description: Segment each session with SAMSEG from its T1w and FLAIR, lesions included: a label map and the volumes of the brain's structures and its white-matter lesions, with the intracranial volume. One session is one unit; CPU, about 45 minutes a session.

checks.description: An intracranial volume under 0.9 litres is a failed segmentation more often than a head
Over 2.3 litres the segmentation took more than the head

parameters.name: Segment lesions
parameters.description: on reads the FLAIR beside the T1w and segments white-matter lesions (label 99); off segments the anatomy from the T1w alone, in about a quarter of the time.

parameters.name: Separate pallidum
parameters.description: Segment the pallidum as a class of its own rather than with the putamen.

parameters.name: Threads
parameters.description: The threads SAMSEG uses for one session.

columns.name: intracranial
columns.description: SAMSEG's intracranial volume (sbTIV)

columns.name: lesions
columns.description: White-matter lesion volume, label 99; absent when lesions were off

descriptor.name: samseg-lesions
descriptor.description: Segment each session with SAMSEG from its T1w and FLAIR, lesions included: a label map and the volumes of the brain's structures and its white-matter lesions, with the intracranial volume. One session is one unit; CPU, about 45 minutes a session.

inputs.name: Segment lesions
inputs.description: on reads the FLAIR beside the T1w and segments white-matter lesions (label 99); off segments the anatomy from the T1w alone, in about a quarter of the time.

inputs.name: Separate pallidum
inputs.description: Segment the pallidum as a class of its own rather than with the putamen.

inputs.name: Threads
inputs.description: The threads SAMSEG uses for one session.

descriptor.command-line: bash -c 'set -u; shopt -s nullglob; cd [InputDataset]; for f in sub-*/ses-*/anat/*_T1w.nii.gz; do a=$(dirname "$f"); d=[OutputLocation]/$a; mkdir -p "$d"; b=$(basename "$f" .nii.gz); b=${b%_T1w}; w=$(mktemp -d [OutputLocation]/.work-XXXXXX); fl=""; for g in $a/*_FLAIR.nii.gz; do fl=$g; break; done; if [ "[LESION]" = on ]; then if [ -z "$fl" ]; then echo "$a holds no FLAIR, so no lesions"; rm -rf "$w"; continue; fi; fspython -c "import sys, surfa; surfa.load_volume(sys.argv[1]).resample_like(surfa.load_volume(sys.argv[2])).save(sys.argv[3])" "$fl" "$f" "$w/flair.mgz" || { rm -rf "$w"; continue; }; run_samseg -i "$f" -i "$w/flair.mgz" --lesion --lesion-mask-pattern 0 1 -o "$w/out" --threads [THREADS] [PALLIDUM] || { rm -rf "$w"; continue; }; else run_samseg -i "$f" -o "$w/out" --threads [THREADS] [PALLIDUM] || { rm -rf "$w"; continue; }; fi; fspython -c "import sys, surfa; surfa.load_volume(sys.argv[1]).save(sys.argv[2])" "$w/out/seg.mgz" "$d/${b}_desc-samseg_dseg.nii.gz" || { rm -rf "$w"; continue; }; fspython -c "import sys, json; print(json.dumps(dict((p[0].strip(), float(p[1])) for n in (\"samseg.stats\", \"sbtiv.stats\") for l in open(sys.argv[1] + \"/\" + n) if l.startswith(\"# Measure\") for p in [l[9:].split(\",\")])))" "$w/out" > "$d/${b}_desc-samseg_volumes.json"; rm -rf "$w"; done'

columns.name: intracranial
columns.description: SAMSEG's intracranial volume (sbTIV)

columns.name: lesions
columns.description: White-matter lesion volume, label 99; absent when lesions were off

qc.description: An intracranial volume under 0.9 litres is a failed segmentation more often than a head
Over 2.3 litres the segmentation took more than the head

descriptor.name: freesurfer-recon-all
descriptor.description: Run FreeSurfer 8.2.0 recon-all on each session's T1-weighted image: the subject folder as one archive, and the volumes of aseg with the intracranial volume and the surface holes as a table. One session is one unit; CPU, hours a session, the lab's licence.

inputs.name: Threads
inputs.description: The threads recon-all's OpenMP steps use.

descriptor.command-line: bash -c 'set -u; shopt -s nullglob; cd [InputDataset]; for f in sub-*/ses-*/anat/*_T1w.nii.gz; do a=$(dirname "$f"); s=$(echo "${a%/anat}" | tr / _); d=[OutputLocation]/$a; mkdir -p "$d"; w=$(mktemp -d [OutputLocation]/.work-XXXXXX); recon-all -all -s "$s" -i "$f" -sd "$w" -threads [THREADS] || { rm -rf "$w"; continue; }; SUBJECTS_DIR="$w" asegstats2table --subjects "$s" --meas volume --tablefile "$d/${s}_desc-aseg_volumes.tsv"; tar -C "$w" -czf "$d/${s}_desc-freesurfer_subject.tar.gz" "$s"; rm -rf "$w"; done'

columns.description: Topological defects of the surfaces before fixing
